mapper.sql:
FROM post p JOIN board b ON b.company_id = p.company_id AND b.board_id = p.board_id JOIN employee e ON e.company_id = p.company_id AND e.employee_id = p.author_employee_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.company_id = e.company_id AND d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE p.company_id = #{companyId} AND b.board_type = 'BOARD_NOTICE' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.visible_yn = 'Y'
AND (p.title LIKE '%' || #{w} || '%' OR p.content LIKE '%' || #{w} || '%')
mapper.select:
SELECT p.post_id AS id, 'ALL' AS scope, p.title AS title, e.employee_name AS writerName, d.department_name AS writerDept, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, CASE WHEN p.updated_at > p.created_at + INTERVAL '1' SECOND THEN TO_CHAR(p.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') END AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment c WHERE c.company_id = p.company_id AND c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_file f WHERE f.company_id = p.company_id AND f.post_id = p.post_id) AS fileCount
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.post_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.post_id AS id, 'ALL' AS scope, p.title AS title, p.content AS content, e.employee_name AS writerName, d.department_name AS writerDept, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, CASE WHEN p.updated_at > p.created_at + INTERVAL '1' SECOND THEN TO_CHAR(p.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') END AS updatedAt FROM post p JOIN board b ON b.company_id = p.company_id AND b.board_id = p.board_id JOIN employee e ON e.company_id = p.company_id AND e.employee_id = p.author_employee_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.company_id = e.company_id AND d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.post_id = #{postId} AND b.board_type = 'BOARD_NOTICE' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.visible_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, updated_at = CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP)
UPDATE post SET deleted_at = CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP), status_code = 'POST_REMOVED'
mapper.select: SELECT c.post_comment_id AS id, c.content AS text, c.author_employee_id AS authorId, e.employee_name AS writerName, d.department_name AS writerDept, TO_CHAR(c.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt FROM post_comment c JOIN employee e ON e.company_id = c.company_id AND e.employee_id = c.author_employee_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.company_id = e.company_id AND d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE c.company_id = #{companyId} AND c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at, c.post_comment_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comment (company_id, post_id, author_employee_id, content) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{postId}, #{authorId}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB})
mapper.select: SELECT a.attachment_id AS id, a.original_name AS name, a.byte_size AS "size", a.mime_type AS "type" -- SIZE·TYPE는 Oracle 예약어라 따옴표로 감싼다 FROM post_file f JOIN attachment a ON a.company_id = f.company_id AND a.attachment_id = f.attachment_id WHERE f.company_id = #{companyId} AND f.post_id = #{postId} AND a.status_code != 'FILE_REMOVED' ORDER BY f.created_at, a.attachment_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_file (company_id, post_id, attachment_id) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{postId}, #{attachmentId})
mapper.select: SELECT MIN(board_id) FROM board WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND board_type = 'BOARD_NOTICE' AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (company_id, board_name, board_type) VALUES (#{companyId}, '공지사항', 'BOARD_NOTICE')
